subject: Request: 15-minute engineering check before product demo
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex@brightcart.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick engineering check before demo

Hi Olga,

Thanks for following up — we signed up on the self-serve page and would like a short 15-minute technical check with an engineer before we move to a full product demo. We want to confirm compatibility with our on-prem stack and ask a couple of latency/throughput questions.

A few quick notes to help prep:
- We're running a hybrid on-prem + GCP setup (K8s with private nodes)
- Main concern is inference latency for sub-200ms per-request SLA at P90
- We'll likely use the API for re-ranking and short-window generation (<=512 tokens)

Are you able to do a 15-minute call tomorrow? Any engineer who can speak to deployment options and network requirements would be great.

Best,
Alex Torres
Senior Engineering Manager
BrightCart Inc.

Attachments: brightcart-network-architecture.pdf (referenced)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex@brightcart.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 18:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick engineering check before demo

Hi Alex — thanks for the details and for signing up. Happy to get a short technical screen scheduled. We can cover deployment patterns, network requirements, and expected latency for the workload you described.

Three quick windows I have available (PDT):
- Wed 2028-04-03 09:30–09:45
- Wed 2028-04-03 11:00–11:15
- Wed 2028-04-03 16:15–16:30

If none of those work, send a couple options and we’ll accommodate. Joining from our side: Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer) will handle the technical questions; Marissa Cole (your AE) is looped in for next steps.

Also: could you confirm whether you need a private VPC deployment or will a dedicated hosted instance be acceptable for the demo phase? That will determine whether we prep network steps or demo with hosted endpoints.

Thanks — I’ll attach a short pre-demo checklist and drop a Calendly link if you'd rather pick a slot there.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
SDR, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-pre-demo-invite.ics (calendar stub)

From: Alex Torres <alex@brightcart.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Apr 2028 01:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick engineering check before demo

Thanks, Olga — 11:00–11:15 PDT works for us. Adding a couple of clarifications so Ben can prep:
- We will probably pursue a private VPC deployment eventually, but for the initial evaluation hosted dedicated capacity is fine.
- Our team will include me plus one infra engineer (name: Priya R.) who will ask network questions.
- We care most about cold-start and concurrent request behavior (estimate: 30 RPS burst, typical sustained 3–5 RPS).

I'm attaching a one-page network diagram (brightcart-network-architecture.pdf). If Ben can briefly cover cold-start mitigation, batching, and recommended sequence-length profiles for best latency that would be ideal.

See you at 11:00 PDT.

Alex

Alex — confirmed for Wed 2028-04-03 at 11:00–11:15 PDT. Calendar invite sent (attached). Joining from Redwood: Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer) and Marissa Cole (Account Exec).

Quick agenda for the 15 minutes:
1) BrightCart goals (2–3 mins) — Alex
2) Network/deployment requirements & constraints (5–6 mins) — Alex + Priya
3) Ben covers cold-start, batching, and recommended model/profile options (5–6 mins)
4) Next steps and full demo scheduling (1 min)

If Priya wants to drop any specific firewall or proxy details ahead of time, reply and Ben will review before the call. See you shortly.
